sv.title: Satellitbilderna pekar ut Putins skräckvapen
sv.summary: Putins skräckvapen Satan II kan ha tagits i bruk. Det visar en ny analys från tankesmedjan IISS som granskat satellitbilder av ryska militära anläggningar, skriver Newsweek.

en.title: Satellite images point to Putin's dreaded weapon
en.summary: Putin's dreaded weapon Satan II may have been put into use. This is shown by a new analysis from the think tank IISS, which has examined satellite images of Russian military facilities, Newsweek writes.
